in_sanskrit.name: प्राणजल्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who offers or gives Prana or life energy, a sacred offering to the gods.

in_marathi.name: Pranjal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranjal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pranjal means gentle wave. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pran' which means life and 'jal' which means wave. This name signifies the gentle and soothing nature of life's waves, symbolizing the ebb and flow of emotions and experiences.

vedic_reference.note: Pranjal is derived from the Sanskrit word Prana, meaning life, and Jal, meaning water. In Vedic traditions, offering Prana or life energy to the gods through rituals is considered an important practice. Pranjal can be seen as a name that symbolizes this offering or sacrifice.
